visualQA.note: Named article sections, all eight original reference images, both full patch posters and relevant readable crops inspected. Female views lead all three galleries. Full frames remain accessible; decorative text/logo columns are omitted where a clean deliberate character crop is usable. Raw originals stay in temporary staging and are excluded from Git. No browser/device verification claimed here. Preview boundaries were revised to retain complete heads/hair and the sword hand before final review. The female sword crop includes both blade point and pommel; the complete lower garment remains in the full frame. Selector previews were regenerated from the final presentation displays so their aspect ratios match the gallery selectors.

contextualCouponEvidence.conditions: One of each coupon claimed in the event. Use at most one per purchase; cannot stack with another coupon or discount. Exact eligibility/application for the three individual new appearances was not independently verified, so their canonical fixed prices are retained.

existingCorrectionEvidence.tailoredSection: 优化修复 → 体验优化 → 外观
existingCorrectionEvidence.tailoredQuoteOriginal: 套装【岁星方朔】新增裁造款式【天星澈夜】。
existingCorrectionEvidence.tailoredDecision: Replace the prior unknown/in-development-only tailored statement for 岁星方朔 with the named October 30 patch addition. Preserve the original announced October 23 main listing; no separate exact first-availability instant for the tailored style is established. No new cosmetic record/media for this style without a separate identified reference.
existingCorrectionEvidence.bugfixSection: 优化修复 → BUG修复 → 外观
bugfixQuotesOriginal: 修复了上衣「岁星方朔」部分模型显示异常，以及结算演出中臀部在特定动作下异常穿模的问题。
修复了女款上衣「渡无常」袖摆在特定动作下异常穿模的问题。
existingCorrectionEvidence.releaseDecision: The past-tense named correction statements support CN item presence by October 30 for 岁星方朔 and 渡无常 only. Do not use this to confirm the other October 23 items or the three newly announced October 30 appearances. The exact first release day remains unverified; preserve October 23 as the earlier announced date, not independently verified actual day.

recommendedRegionalHandling.note: The main appearance was planned for October 23 and is directly mentioned in the October 30 corrective patch. The evidence confirms presence by October 30; it does not independently verify the exact actual first-release date. Retain the announced date in cnRelease with its basis/scope rather than represent it as a verified actual day.
